$comment: Each attestor is a Schema.org Person (https://schema.org/Person). Documented at https://fossfoundation.info/crosswalk#attestors
title: Crosswalk Attestors Schema
description: People whose human-attested crosswalk evidence counts as confirmed. Adding someone is itself a reviewed pull request. Attestations here are given by volunteers. They may represent informed observations, but they have not been legally reviewed to qualify as attestations under the EU Cyber Resilience Act or other legislation, and the project does not claim its tools are certified to comply with it. See https://fossfoundation.info/crosswalk#legal-status.

sameAs.title: Same as
sameAs.description: Profile URLs that identify the person, such as GitHub, ORCID or Wikidata.

memberOf.title: Organizations
memberOf.description: Optional. The organizations the attestor is associated with, each with their role there if they have one: for example an officer at one foundation and a director at another, or an attestor for several foundations. Leave it out when the attestor is not associated with any organization.
memberOf.$comment: Schema.org memberOf with OrganizationRole items, following the Schema.org Role pattern: https://schema.org/memberOf, https://schema.org/OrganizationRole

memberOf.title: Organization
memberOf.description: The identifier of a _foundations or _entities record, or, for an organization not listed on this site, the URL of its website.

roleName.title: Role
roleName.description: Optional. The attestor's role at that organization, for example Board Member or VP Infrastructure.

keyFingerprint.title: Signing key fingerprint
keyFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the OpenPGP or SSH key the attestor signs commits with, if any.
